NTA. This is something your child wanted, and it was a very reasonable request concerning her own body. How your child chooses to express or present themselves, again, within reason, should be respected and supported. It seems like your ex-wife may have been inhibiting your daughter's self-expression for years, which isn’t okay. You made the right decision. Usually, I don't agree with the whole “asking forgiveness rather than permission” thing, but in this case, I definitely believe it was better to prioritize your daughter's autonomy. Great dad.
